Integration.Name: ! billion rows challenge
Integration.Comments:
Retrieves temperature measurement values from a csv file and calculates the min, mean, and max temperature per weather station
The csv file has a simple structure with one measurement value per row:
Hamburg,12.0 Bulawayo,8.9 Palembang,38.8 Hamburg,34.2 St. John's,15.2 Cracow,12.6 ... etc. ...
it outputs to a csv file the min, mean, and max values per station. As an example of the expected output for the first three stations:
Hamburg,12.0,23.1,34.2 Bulawayo,8.9,22.1,35.2 Palembang,38.8,39.9,41.0
